environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed in a Kubernetes pod with a hardened security context. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted exclusively at /opt/app/storage/workspaces. The pod security context specifies runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534, and drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) is applied. The container image uses a distroless Ruby base. The emptyDir volume has a sizeLimit of 50Mi and is the ONLY writable path in the container filesystem.
